story.title: Kenya Reports Eighth Ebola Case Amid Regional Outbreak
story.summary: Kenya has confirmed its eighth case of Ebola as the outbreak continues to spread in the region. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the outbreak has now reached an eighth province, North Ubangi, where two cases have been reported, including one fatality.
sources: AP - Top News via Google News

timeline_highlights.title: Congolese Politician Beaten After Promoting Ebola Awareness
timeline_highlights.summary: Marie-Celestin Karondwa, a politician from the ruling UDPS party in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was beaten on Sunday after advocating for Ebola awareness during a radio interview. The incident occurred in Butembo, a region experiencing an Ebola outbreak, as residents reacted violently to his message promoting disease prevention measures.
key_facts: Marie-Celestin Karondwa was a member of the UDPS party.
He was attacked after a radio interview about Ebola awareness.
The incident took place in Butembo, North Kivu province.

timeline_highlights.title: Kenya Reports First Confirmed Ebola Case and Death Following Return from DRC
timeline_highlights.summary: Kenya has confirmed its first-ever case of Ebola, resulting in the death of a man who had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Health authorities have identified 28 contacts of the deceased as they monitor the situation closely. The outbreak in the DRC has been severe, with over 4,000 deaths reported this year.
key_facts: First confirmed Ebola case in Kenya.
The patient died after returning from the DRC.
28 contacts have been traced by health authorities.

timeline_highlights.title: Kenya Reports First Ebola Death and Traces 28 Contacts
timeline_highlights.summary: Kenya has confirmed its first-ever Ebola death, involving a Kenyan citizen who had returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The health minister announced that 28 contacts of the deceased have been identified as authorities respond to the outbreak. The situation has raised concerns among health workers and residents in Nairobi, prompting calls for better protection measures for medical personnel.

timeline_highlights.title: Children Bear Heavy Toll in DRC's Severe Ebola Outbreak
timeline_highlights.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing its deadliest Ebola outbreak, with children particularly affected. Reports indicate that more than 1 in 4 of the deaths are among children, who face a staggering 60% fatality rate. This outbreak is caused by a rare strain of the virus for which there is currently no approved treatment.

related_stories.summary: France's President Macron has condemned the violent protests that erupted across the country over the weekend. The unrest, characterized by looting and clashes, has raised concerns about his political authority and increased his isolation amid ongoing tensions.

related_stories.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Found Guilty of 191 Murders
related_stories.summary: A Kenyan court has found Paul Mackenzie, a self-proclaimed preacher, and his associates responsible for the murders of 191 people, primarily children, linked to a starvation cult. The verdict was delivered on Monday, with Mackenzie having denied the charges, claiming he did not order the victims to starve in order to 'meet Jesus.'

related_stories.title: Australian MP Helen Haines Critically Injured in Apparent Vehicle Attack
related_stories.summary: Independent MP Helen Haines is in critical condition after being struck by a vehicle outside her office in Wangaratta, Victoria. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that the incident appears to be a deliberate attack, and a man has been arrested in connection with the event. This incident has raised concerns about the safety of politicians in Australia.

related_stories.title: Tragic Drownings Claim Lives of 12 Migrants Off Greek Islands
related_stories.summary: In two separate incidents off the Greek islands of Lesbos and Samos, 12 migrants, including an infant, have drowned. Authorities reported that another 22 individuals were rescued, and a search-and-rescue operation is currently ongoing.
